That is a very fair question! To be completely honest, the Hybrid mattress is already an excellent choice and is perfectly fine for most sleepers. It offers firm support and high quality materials that will last for years.

The Premium Hybrid mattress is worth the extra investment specifically if you value these two things:

Versatility: With its reversible integrated topper, you can switch between a soft or firm feel whenever you want. This is great if your preferences change or if you are not exactly sure what level of firmness you prefer.
Temperature Control: It uses graphite-infused foam which is even more effective at dissipating heat (up to 17% more), making it ideal if you tend to get hot during the night.
